about: With quality-baseline.json the hook passes --touched, stages a lowered baseline with the commit, restores it when the commit fails, refuses an unstaged edit to it, puts back the index a `git commit <path>` leaves, refuses a file staged in part, holds a staged baseline that raises a count over HEAD's, and holds a not-lowered file for the message only when a commit-msg hook can read it: an executable one, the repository's own behind the global hooks' stubs. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE hooks/pre-commit.sh tests/test_install_hooks.py tests/mutants/jpt-ratchet-on-hook.json
